thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH 5xx rate detected in region az2 (service: inference-hosted-api). Trigger: rolling_5m_5xx > 2.5% :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Incident PD-48712 created and routed to primary on-call alex_chen. Pager: page fired -> alex_chen.
alex_chen: Acked PD-48712 :white_check_mark: I'm on it. Quick summary pls if anyone else sees this.
ops-bot: Automated healthcheck summary: az2: 5xx_rate=3.8%, 429_rate=1.2%, avg_p95_latency=480ms, gpu_util=92% (last 1m).
alex_chen: Seeing lots of 503s and intermittent 429s from the hosted endpoints. Dashboards show a spike around 2050123390, sustained. Autoscaler logs show repeated scale-down -> scale-up cycles for the inference pool in az2. Suspect autoscaler loop causing evictions and cold starts.
maria_garcia: Confirming, I see kvcache eviction churn in az2 pods and many cache misses. That will amplify cold-start latency.
samir_patel: Can we activate routing fallback to other AZs? Recommend rolling 15% traffic to az1 as a canary to reduce customer impact while we triage.
alex_chen: Good call. I'll open the routing policy for canary. Executing now.
alex_chen: ```
# route-rules apply
route set --service=inference-hosted-api --from=az2 --to=az1 --percent=15 --reason="PD-48712 canary fallback"
```
ops-bot: Route change submitted. New distribution: az2=85%, az1=15%. Monitoring.
jess_ortega: Notifying support/CS about impact and affected customers (hosted API customers, some Dedicated instances in az2 showing error bursts). Sending a short status note. :mailbox_with_mail:
jess_ortega: "Heads up: We're seeing elevated 5xx/429 rates in eu-west az2. We've routed 15% of traffic to az1 as a canary while we mitigate. We'll update in 15m or on changes."
maria_garcia: While routing drains, I'm going to pin autoscaler config to prevent further scale-downs. Then we can roll a config fix.
alex_chen: Manual scale-up in az2 to stabilize traffic: ```kubectl scale --replicas=40 deployment/inference-pool-az2 -n prod```
ops-bot: Scale command accepted and nodes requested. Cloud autoscaler reports spot eviction events correlated with scale-downs.
samir_patel: I pushed a temporary autoscaler override to maintain min_replicas=30. That should stop the down->up churn.
maria_garcia: Verified pod counts rising and kvcache miss rate dropping. 5xx rate trending down from 3.8% -> 1.5% after scale + routing.
alex_chen: PD escalation timer: if anyone sees repeat pages or >5m unacked, escalate to eng-leads. For now I'll stay IC.
PagerDuty: PD-48712 acknowledged by alex_chen. Escalation paused.
jess_ortega: Small customer impact noted in status page. Updating with "Partial mitigation in progress; degraded performance in eu-west az2. Fallback routing active."
alex_chen: Can we confirm no Dedicated customers are fully offline? Maria, Samir, any Dedicated pool alarms?
maria_garcia: A few Dedicated jobs in az2 showing retries but none fully offline. Telemetry from tenants A and C show elevated latency but successful responses after retries.
samir_patel: We've opened a few extra GPU instances in az2 to replace evicted machines; working with cloud team to mark instances as not-evictable temporarily.
ops-bot: Metric snapshot (post-change): az2_5xx=1.3%, az2_429=0.6%, p95_latency=320ms. Overall account-level errors down 60% from peak.
alex_chen: Good. Let's keep the routing fallback at 15% for the next 20m, monitor. If stable, we'll gradually move back to normal.
jess_ortega: I've updated customers and escalated to account managers for the biggest tenants.
alex_chen: After 25m monitoring, errors have normalized. Rolling routing back to az2=100% in 5m unless we see regression.
alex_chen: Executing rollback: ```route set --service=inference-hosted-api --from=az2 --to=az1 --percent=0 --reason="PD-48712 rollback - stable"```
ops-bot: Route change submitted. Traffic back to az2=100%.
maria_garcia: I'll keep the autoscaler override in place until after the postmortem and a proper config patch.
samir_patel: Filed a follow-up ticket INF-1209 to remove root cause (autoscaler signal handling + eviction detection) and add alarms to detect scale-loop behavior.
PagerDuty: PD-48712 resolved by alex_chen. Incident closed.
alex_chen: Handing off to maria_garcia to lead the postmortem and remediation. Maria, please include timeline, root cause, remediation, and customer impact in INF-1209.
maria_garcia: Will do. Initial notes captured. Thanks all for fast responses. :heart:
jess_ortega: Marking incident as "customer-notified" and scheduling a follow-up update in 48h.
alex_chen: IC sign-off. Handoff complete.

Reactions: :thumbsup: (many), :shipit:, :coffee:

Attachments: brief logs and one-line commands pasted above; no large transcripts.
